exposure: Body dissatisfaction (measured using the Appearance Evaluation (AE) scale and Body Areas Satisfaction Scale (BASS))
outcome: Depressive symptoms (measured using the Edinburgh Postnatal Depression Scale (EPDS))
finding: Body dissatisfaction was significantly associated with depressive symptoms at 4-6 weeks postpartum.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was significantly associated with body dissatisfaction and predicted postpartum depressive symptoms.
